entries.title: Extension pagination — list views and board columns
entries.what_changed: US-0097 paginates Versions/Sprints/Epics lists (Show 25/50/100). US-0098 adds per-column board pagination with independent page state; board defaults to All versions and All epics; Epics view drops redundant epic filter; lists sort by artifact id.
entries.why_changed: Large docs/ trees need bounded rendering; board columns have different card counts and must paginate independently.
entries.impact: Extension 0.3.0 polish complete for EPIC-05 read surface; sort asc/desc remains future US.

entries.title: Extension planning views split + Sync Board
entries.what_changed: Replaced Deliverables with Versions (no filter), Sprints (version filter), Epics (version+epic filters). Sync Board writes board.json via TypeScript. Extension 0.3.0.
entries.why_changed: Managers needed organized surfaces per artifact type; board.json sync was stub while validate still expects derived file.
entries.impact: openDeliverables aliases openVersions; US-0045 partially satisfied in extension.

entries.title: v4 go-live — extension read surface complete
entries.what_changed: Marked v4 and EPIC-05 complete. Board + Deliverables editor tabs with All/None filters; Validate runs validate_meridian.py; architecture § VS Code extension rewritten; US-0093 closes v4-S4.
entries.why_changed: v4-S1–S3 shipped product; docs still showed planned and accordions/filters needed parity before calling the release done.
entries.impact: Dogfood via pnpm install:cursor; v5 owns sync/new US from extension and Marketplace publish.

entries.title: v4 repivot — kanban in IDE, not sync bridge
entries.what_changed: v4 outcome is Board + Deliverables webviews in VS Code/Cursor reading docs/; sync/new-US commands deferred to v5; browser monitor optional; old v4-S2 script bridge deprioritized.
entries.why_changed: Manager needs visual kanban in the editor; AI agents already sync US and board.json — extension as command shell adds little value.
entries.impact: Next implementation is v4-S2 Board webview reusing monitor domain logic; US-0044–0049 plan superseded until new US are created.

entries.title: v2.01 go-live — local file server documented
entries.affected_document: app-desktop/docs/versions/v2.01.md, app-desktop/docs/05_architecture.md, app-desktop/docs/08_environments.md, app-desktop/docs/sprints/v2.01-S1.md, EPIC-02, EPIC-06
entries.what_changed: Marked version v2.01 complete with go-live checklist; added sprint v2.01-S1; documented Vite file-server plugin and HTTP folder adapter in 05_architecture; dogfooding path flow in 08_environments; EPIC-06 complete, EPIC-02 notes v2.01 transport.
entries.why_changed: US-0087 and US-0088 were done but the release stayed planned and architecture still described picker-only dev flow.
entries.impact: Managers can start v4 (VS Code bridge) without an open v2.01 hygiene item; dev workflow is F5-safe with documented contract.

entries.title: Scrum map as agent operational reference
entries.what_changed: Added scrum-meridian-map.md with synthesis diagram and rules; moved scrum-guia-completo to kit as human-only; wired agents/templates; monitor How it works section; closed US-0088 in v2.01.
entries.why_changed: Scrum guide was added for humans but agents could load it every session and invent non-Meridian artifacts (tasks folders, story points).
entries.impact: Agents use map only unless manager asks for full guia; INVEST R14 and sprint priority documented without schema changes; EPIC-06 active for v2.01.
